Kuvitus: maantie maaseudulla aamupäiväll: Illustration: a country road in the late morning. The traffic light has turned green and a car starts moving from the stop line. Ahead of it on the road a cyclist is already pedalling at a steady speed. Behind the car there is a puff of exhaust and behind the cyclist there are speed lines. Marker posts stand at equal intervals along the road, and in the background there are a field, a red house, birches and a spruce forest.
Kaavakuva, jossa kaksi kappaletta on sam: Formula figure, to scale, with two bodies on the same x-axis. At the top, at t = 0, body A is at 0 m and moves to the right at 3.0 m/s, and body B is at 60 m and moves to the left at 2.0 m/s. At the bottom, at t = 12 s, both are at 36 m: the bodies have met. The velocity arrows are blue and of different lengths.
(t,x)-kuvaaja mittakaavassa kahdesta tas: (t,x) graph, to scale, of two uniform motions. Body A starts from 0 m and moves at 3.0 m/s: the line rises. Body B starts from 60 m at −2.0 m/s: the line falls. The lines intersect at the point where t = 12 s and x = 36 m. Dashed lines lead from the point to the axes.
(t,x)-kuvaaja mittakaavassa: paikaltaan: (t,x) graph, to scale: car A starting from rest and cyclist B moving from the same place at a constant 6.0 m/s. The position of the car is the parabola x = t², that of the cyclist a straight line. The graphs intersect twice: at t = 0, when the bodies are at the same place at the start, and at t = 6.0 s at the place 36 m.
(t,v)-kuvaaja mittakaavassa samasta liik: (t,v) graph, to scale, of the same motion as the previous graph. The velocity of the car grows as a straight line from zero, and the velocity of the cyclist is a constant 6.0 m/s. Until t = 3.0 s the cyclist is ahead and the lead grows: the area between the lines corresponds to a growth of the lead of 9 m. From 3.0 s to 6.0 s the car reduces the lead, and the area corresponds to a decrease of 9 m. At t = 6.0 s the car has caught up with the cyclist.
(t,x)-kuvaaja mittakaavassa esimerkin ti: (t,x) graph, to scale, of the situation in the example: cyclist B is at first 16 m ahead of car A and moves at 6.0 m/s; the car starts from rest with an acceleration of 2.0 m/s². The line x = 16 + 6t and the parabola x = t² intersect at t = 8.0 s at the place 64 m.
(t,x)-kuvaaja mittakaavassa kahdesta tas: (t,x) graph, to scale, of two uniform motions. Cart A starts from 0 m and moves uniformly to 60 m by 10 s. Cart B starts from 40 m and moves uniformly to 20 m by 10 s. The lines intersect inside the graph. The meeting point is not marked.

(t,x) graph, to scale, of two uniform motions. Car A starts from 0 m at 3.0 m/s and cyclist B from 20 m at 5.0 m/s. The line of the cyclist is above the line of the car all the time and rises more steeply, so the lines move apart.
